name: insurance-web-factory
description: Cloudflare Workers 기반 보험설계사 멀티사이트 팩토리

scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run build:studio && npm run validate:sites && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run generate && npm run build:studio && wrangler dev
scripts.preview: npm run generate && npm run build:studio && tsc -p tsconfig.preview.json && node scripts/local-preview.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run generate && npm run build:studio && npm run validate:sites && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:domains: npm run domains:generate && npm run build:studio && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.domains.jsonc
